build_cse_codegen: build a Python module that performs CSE code generation on SymPy symbols and outputs C code
create_cse_helper_variables: create C-style const scalar variables from SymPy common subexpression elimination helper expressions
run_cse_codegen: run the cse_codegen function on a list of SymPy symbols to generate optimized C code output
test_cse_codegen: test the cse_codegen function by passing SymPy symbols and verifying the returned StringIO contains valid C code
refactor_cse_codegen: refactor the cse_codegen function to support multiple output expressions instead of asserting exactly one result
